policy: Explicit legacy inventory for tasks whose declared eval_time_seconds and enforced run_eval.py EVAL_TIMEOUT_S already disagree by more than the reconciliation bounds. Pending is a recorded defect, never a pass: the entry pins the pair it was written against, so moving either number makes the entry stale and re-checks the ratio. Remove a task after its metadata and wrapper agree.

bounds.rationale: min is the generator's own default (max(300, 3 * eval_time_seconds)); max is an order of magnitude past the widest legitimate margin in the inventory, so a declaration wrong by orders of magnitude is caught while a merely conservative one is not.

InformationTheory/ShannonCapacityCertifi.reason: Declared cost is 1 s while the enforced timeout is 720 s - a 720x margin against a ceiling of 100x. Only the declaration can be wrong by that much; the wrapper is the side that stopped an evaluation.

branch_scope.note: Current migration entries only; original unsplit records remain in Git history.
